items.q: The other five numbers recorded on that date had Christian Wagner clarinet and alto...

ctx.x: Jimmy Donaghue, Barbara Houtton's brother, also used to hang out with the orchestra. If we would go to a cafe after work, he would often come along. I don't know how interested in jazz he was, but he certainly seemed interested in the band.

The 3rd of July, I had another concert at the Ecole Normale de Musique. Alberta Hunter, the blues singer, Garland Wilson, a pianist-singer, and Chittison with the orchestra of Christian Wagner were the other participants, and the place was packed to standing room only. Alberta Hunter had been in Europe for quite some time but Garland Wilson, who was not a real jazz pianist, played an exciting entertainers type of piano and had not been in France very long. I had seen Garland on the stage of the Apollo in Harlem a…

On July 15th, the Willie Lewis orchestra left Paris for a place called [Knukke] Knocke in Belgium, with all the orchestra wives. This was my first time to go to Belgium and it was always thrilling for me to visit a place I had never been before and have time to discover something of that place.
